title: 7BR Oasis with Resort Pool & Swim-Up Bar
description:
Escape to a luxury Scottsdale oasis near Old Town! This remodeled home sleeps 14+, perfect for groups. Features a private resort-style backyard with a pool, swim-up bar, and hot tub. Inside, enjoy a game room with a pool table and shuffleboard. Walk to Scottsdale's best shops, dining, and nightlife. Your ultimate Arizona getaway awaits!
AZ TPT License #: 21593302
STR License #: 2042800

 The space 
Stay at Wild West Estate – Your Luxury Escape Near Old Town Scottsdale

Welcome to Wild West Estate, your newly remodeled dream getaway just steps from the edge of Old Town Scottsdale! Less than a mile from the action, this upscale vacation rental puts you right near Scottsdale’s world-famous restaurants, boutique shops, buzzing nightlife, and nearly 200 top-rated golf courses. Whether you're here for a weekend escape, a golf trip, or a sun-soaked group getaway, this home has everything you need—and more.

No parties, no loud outdoor noise—just good vibes and great memories.

Why You'll Love It:

 ✅ Recently completely remodeled with high-end finishes
 ✅ Close to Old Town Scottsdale
 ✅ Sleeps up to 14+ guests comfortably
 ✅ Resort-style backyard with pool, spa, and swim-up bar
 ✅ Professionally designed with modern rustic charm
 ✅ Perfect for family reunions, golf retreats, and extended stays

Inside the Wild West Estate:

Step into an airy, open-concept living space where industrial style meets southwestern warmth. Think wood-paneled ceilings, brick accent walls, and natural light pouring through oversized windows. This newly remodeled estate blends elegance and comfort in every detail—designed to feel like home, only better.

The Bedrooms:

 Master Suite: King bed, sleeper sofa, lounge space — your private desert retreat
 Bedroom 2: King bed, TV, and en-suite bathroom
 Bedroom 3: King bed with shared hallway bath (shared with room 4)
 Bedroom 4: Queen Bed with shared hallway bath (shared with room 3)
 Bedroom 5: Queen bed with private en-suite
 Casitas: Two casita-style rooms, each with 1 Queen bed and 1 shared bathroom—great for groups or kids!

Backyard Vibes:

You’ll never want to leave the private resort-style backyard. Grill up dinner at the BBQ with a swim-up bar, take a dip in the pool or hot tub, or unwind in the shaded patio area with ceiling fans and comfy seating. There’s even Bocce Ball for some friendly competition under the Arizona sun.

Good to Know:

 📅 Weekday Minimum Stay: 2 nights (Mon–Wed)
 📅 Weekend Minimum Stay: 3 nights (Thurs–Sun)
 ⏳ Discounts available for stays longer than 30 days—just ask us!

“All dwelling units, including Vacation Rentals and Short-term Rentals, shall have a maximum family size of 6 adults (and their related dependent children).” [sic]
📜 AZ TPT License: 21593302
📜 STR License: 2042800

Ready to book your Old Town Scottsdale vacation rental?
Wild West Estate is waiting—grab your crew and get ready to relax, recharge, and explore the best of Scottsdale!

 Guest access 
Guests have full access to the entire property and private amenities. A unique access code will be sent a few days before check-in.

We also offer 24/7 concierge service for restaurant reservations, local tips, and personalized recommendations. We use the DACK app to streamline your stay—unlock doors remotely, request pre-stocked groceries, schedule spa treatments, or book a private chef—all from your phone.

 Other things to note 
Like what you see but it's not quite right? We have some of the nicest vacation rentals in the Scottsdale/Phoenix area ranging from one-bedroom lofts to 10-bedroom estates! All of our homes are in the most desired locations, tastefully designed and updated to the highest hotel quality standards.

OTHER NOTES:
Minimum Night stay requirements:
Weekdays: 2-nights Minimum (Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday)*
Weekends: 3-nights Minimum (Thursday/Friday/Saturday/Sunday)*

*Minimum nights may change depending on Seasons and Holidays and must be approved by Parsons Villas.

* Often times there are last minute specials and reduction in price due to changes in availability and the calendar. Don't miss out and inquire now!

house_rules.quiet_hours:
Additional rules: House Rules – PV Homes & Villas
1. No Parties or Events
This is a peaceful residential home. Absolutely no parties, events, or gatherings without written approval. Violation will result in immediate eviction and a $1,000 fine.

2. No Unregistered Guests
Only guests listed on the reservation are allowed on the property. Unauthorized guests will be charged 10% of the nightly rate per person.

3. No Pets
Pets are not allowed under any circumstances. A $1,000 fee applies if evidence of a pet is found.

4. No Smoking
Smoking or vaping of any kind is strictly prohibited indoors. A $500 deep-cleaning fee will be charged if violated.

5. Quiet Hours: 10PM – 7AM
Per city ordinance, no loud noise, music, or disruptive activity is allowed during this time. Violations may result in immediate removal.

6. Minimum Age to Book: 30
The primary guest must be at least 30 years old and present for the entire stay. ID may be verified upon check-in.

7. Pool Use & Safety
Use the pool at your own risk. No glass near the pool area. Children must be supervised at all times. Pool heating is available for an additional fee and must be arranged prior to check-in.

8. Damage & Cleaning
Guests are responsible for any damage or excessive cleaning required after checkout. A $95 damage waiver covers accidental damage up to $1,500. Additional charges may apply for misuse, missing items, or excessive mess.

9. Early Check-in / Late Checkout
Only available if pre-approved. Unauthorized late checkouts will incur $200 per 30 minutes.

10. Security & Monitoring
Security cameras are installed at exterior entry points only for guest safety and property protection.
